algebra: C=E(DyW9)-E(LaW9)-E(DyW8)+E(LaW8); own-ion and matched free-water contributions cancel for the raw contrast. No new CC/PBE0 mixed CP or B decomposition is permitted.
limits: Eight cluster calculations provide two complete method-consistent raw contrasts and four endpoint shifts.
Small canonical controls assess combined RI/local errors on those fixtures, not cluster CP/B, basis completeness, omitted explicit f/SOC states or a rigorous physical uncertainty.
Tighter pair/PNO/local-fit cutoffs with unchanged domain threshold test sensitivity rather than convergence.
Actual ghost/ECP/AuxC/native correlated-electron and core/semicore inventories must be admitted; source keywords alone are insufficient.

primary_manual_confirmation.findings: DLPNO-CCSD(T1) selects iterative triples; TriTolE is configurable. DLPNO supports conventional integral handling. Chemical core and valence spaces can localize separately even when electrons are correlated; ECP-replaced electrons cannot be correlated.

AuxC serves post-SCF RI correlation. AutoAux can populate correlation slots, and explicit NewAuxCGTO is supported. Real/ghost auxiliary equality and numeric expansions still require actual output verification.
